theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_iso_svol_steiner_slice_volume_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → ∀ y : Euclid d, volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ {x : Euclid d | {s : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j s) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |x j| ≤ (volume {s : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j s) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}} = volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
